info.title: Service Provider API
info.description: Service provider authentication, profile, and marketplace APIs for the convenience backend.

post.description: Updates authenticated provider first and last name. Name change resets ID verification status to keep identity checks aligned with latest profile name.
Generates a fresh phone OTP and sends it to the provided phone number. Existing active OTPs are invalidated.

post.summary: Verify phone OTP and update phone.
post.description: Validates submitted phone OTP, marks it used, then updates phone_number and phone_verified_at.

422.description: Invalid or expired OTP, or validation error.

post.description: Resends a new phone OTP after invalidating active ones. Request frequency is limited to prevent abuse.

429.description: Too many OTP requests in the last 10 minutes.

post.description: Sends an OTP to the provided email for ownership verification before updating email on account.
Resends email OTP for update flow. Previous active OTP is invalidated and recent-attempt limits are enforced.

429.description: Too many OTP requests in the last 10 minutes.

post.summary: Verify email OTP and update email.
post.description: Verifies the submitted email OTP, updates user email, and marks email as verified.

422.description: Invalid or expired OTP, or validation error.

post.description: Compares submitted first and last name with profile names using similarity checks. If matched, marks user ID verification timestamp.

get.description: Returns current provider about_me text from provider profile.

post.description: Creates or updates about_me text for authenticated provider profile.

get.description: Returns the currently stored profile image path for authenticated provider.

post.description: Uploads a new profile image, deletes old one from storage if present, and saves new public URL path.
Sets provider profile background_verification to 'Verified' for authenticated provider.

get.description: Returns provider addresses ordered by default first, then latest created.

post.summary: Create address or set existing default.
post.description: Adds a new address for the provider. If same address coordinates already exist, reuses record and can mark it as default.

get.description: Returns current default address. Responds with 404 when no default address is configured.
Returns single address for edit form.

put.description: Updates existing address values. If is_default=true, all other user addresses are unset as default.

delete.description: Marks address record as deleted using internal status sentinel and keeps historical entry.

post.summary: Sign up using email and send OTP.
post.description: Creates or re-activates a service provider account using email, then sends a 4-digit OTP to verify email ownership. If device token details are provided, they are linked to the account for notifications.

400.description: Email belongs to a non-provider account.

post.description: Validates the latest active OTP for the email, marks email verified, activates account status, and returns bearer token with user/profile verification flags.

422.description: Invalid OTP, expired OTP, or validation error.

post.description: Deactivates previous active OTP records for the user email and sends a fresh OTP email.
Starts phone OTP flow. If the phone is not tied to restricted roles, the endpoint creates or reuses the provider account and sends OTP via SMS.
Validates the latest active OTP for the phone number, marks phone verified, activates account status, and returns bearer token with user/profile verification flags.

422.description: Invalid OTP, expired OTP, or validation error.

post.description: Deactivates previous active OTP records for the phone and sends a fresh OTP SMS.
Creates or reuses provider account based on Facebook email, ensures active status, links optional device token, and returns bearer token with provider verification flags.

400.description: Email belongs to a non-provider account.

post.description: Creates or reuses provider account based on Google email, marks status active, links optional device token, and returns bearer token with provider verification flags.

400.description: Email belongs to a non-provider account.

post.description: Creates or reuses provider account based on Apple user ID, links optional device token and referral code, and returns bearer token with provider verification flags.

post.summary: Send OTP for permanent account deletion.
post.description: Sends OTP to email for an account already in deleted state and waiting for permanent deletion confirmation.

422.description: Validation error or account state does not allow operation.

post.summary: Confirm OTP and permanently delete account.
post.description: Confirms OTP for a deleted provider account and finalizes permanent deletion by setting provider status to deleted.

422.description: Invalid OTP or already permanently deleted.

post.description: Revokes the current Sanctum access token. When a device token is supplied, that push notification token is also removed for the authenticated provider.

403.description: Authenticated user cannot logout from this guard.

post.description: Creates or updates provider availability in a single endpoint. Existing availability and slots are replaced with request payload.

apply_to_all_true.summary: Apply same slots to requested days

get.description: Returns timezone, is_available, apply_to_all, selected days, and day slots.

post.description: Toggles provider profile is_available value. No request body required.

get.description: Returns day master list with id, day_name and short_name.
Returns timezone list with id and timezone name.

post.description: Creates a pending business member invitation for an existing role_id=3 user, assigns service sub-categories, and sends a signed invitation URL that expires in 7 days.

get.summary: List active, pending and archive business members.
get.description: Returns members for the requested business_id with active_count, pending_count, archive_count and members arrays grouped by status.
Returns one member with joined_at and assigned service sub-categories for the provided business_id.

404.description: Business profile or member not found.

delete.description: Soft-removes a member by updating status to deleted for the provided business_id.

404.description: Business profile or member not found.

post.description: Resends invitation email for a pending member and extends invitation expiry by 7 days.

404.description: Business profile or member not found.

422.description: Only pending invitations can be resent.

post.description: Assigns one service sub-category to selected business member for the provided business_id.

404.description: Business profile or member not found.

422.description: Validation error or service not assigned to business.

delete.description: Removes one assigned service sub-category from selected business member for the provided business_id.

404.description: Business profile or member not found.

422.description: Service is not assigned to this member.

post.description: Creates a business record for authenticated provider profile and assigns service sub-categories.

422.description: Validation error or business already exists.

post.description: Updates business details and assigned service sub-categories for the authenticated provider.

get.description: Returns businesses with business id, business name, and assigned service name/logo.
Returns full business record with assigned service sub-categories for update form prefill.

delete.description: Soft deletes selected business for authenticated provider.

post.description: Toggles business status true/false without request payload.

get.summary: General API for listing service categories and subcategories.
get.description: Returns category list with sub_category_list (id/logo/name). By default returns first two categories. Supports search by category or sub-category name.
Returns only assigned services for selected business.
Returns availability override for a single date. If no override exists, returns is_override=false payload.

post.summary: Create or update provider date availability override.
post.description: Creates or updates single-date availability override without modifying weekly availability.

get.description: Returns country list used in provider business profile forms. Supports optional text search by country name.
Returns states for a specific country ID and only includes states that contain at least one city. Supports optional state-name search.
Returns cities for a state ID used by service provider forms. Supports optional city-name search.

post.description: Saves provider personal details (name, email, optional phone). If the email is not yet verified, this endpoint sends a verification email and returns saved profile data.

200.description: Provider profile saved. If email is unverified, a verification link is also sent.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to update this profile.

get.description: Returns authenticated user details along with profile image and background verification status.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to access this resource.

post.description: Generates a delete-account OTP and delivers it to the requested channel. The authenticated user phone or email is used as the destination based on delivery_type.
Verifies the OTP received from send-delete-account-otp and permanently deactivates the account. Requires no active orders. Revokes all tokens and removes device tokens on success.

422.description: Validation error, invalid or expired OTP, or active order restriction.

Experienced service provider with 8+ years in home maintenance.

device_token.description: Optional device token used for push notifications.

device_type.description: Optional device type for push notifications. Defaults to android when a device token is provided.

referral_code.description: Optional referral code provided by another user.

phone.description: Phone number used to start OTP authentication. The current endpoint accepts a string and stores it as the user's phone number.

device_type.description: Optional device type for push notifications. Defaults to android when a device token is provided.

otp.description: Four-digit OTP code delivered to email.

phone.description: Phone number used to receive OTP.

otp.description: Four-digit OTP code delivered by SMS.

restore.description: Set true to restore a soft-deleted provider profile when still in 30-day grace period.

email.description: Email address returned by Facebook OAuth.

first_name.description: First name returned by Facebook. Only letters and spaces are accepted.

last_name.description: Last name returned by Facebook. Only letters and spaces are accepted.

restore.description: Set true to restore a soft-deleted provider profile when still in 30-day grace period.

device_token.description: Optional device token used for push notifications.

device_type.description: Optional device type used for push notifications.

email.description: Email address returned by Google OAuth.

first_name.description: First name returned by Google. Only letters and spaces are accepted.

last_name.description: Last name returned by Google. Only letters and spaces are accepted.

restore.description: Set true to restore a soft-deleted provider profile when still in 30-day grace period.

device_token.description: Optional device token used for push notifications.

device_type.description: Optional device type used for push notifications.

apple_user_id.description: Apple user identifier returned by Apple Sign In.

restore.description: Set true to restore a soft-deleted provider profile when still in 30-day grace period.

device_token.description: Optional device token used for push notifications.

device_type.description: Optional device type used for push notifications.

email.description: Email for a previously deleted provider account.
Email for the deleted provider account.

device_token.description: Optional device token to remove from the authenticated user's push notification devices during logout.

email.description: Email address where the OTP was sent.

phone.description: Phone number where the OTP was sent.

access_token.description: Bearer token used for authenticated requests. In this project, tokens remain valid until explicitly revoked (for example by logout or account deletion).

device_token.description: Device token model stored for this session when a device token was supplied.

message.description: Message varies by endpoint: 'Email verified successfully' for confirm-email, 'Phone number verified successfully' for confirm-number, 'Google login successful', 'Facebook login successful', 'Apple login successful' for social logins.

slots.description: Shared slots only when apply_to_all=true; otherwise empty array.

message.example: End time must be greater than start time.

service_sub_category_ids.description: Service sub-categories assigned to the invited member.

invite_token.description: Encrypted invitation token from email redirect URL.

message.example: The email field must be a valid email address.

AuthUser.description: Authenticated user details returned by login and profile APIs.

BadRequestResponse.description: Returned when request data is syntactically valid but cannot be processed for the requested business action.

message.example: The email is already associated with an account. Please use a different email.

UnauthorizedResponse.description: Laravel default response when a bearer token is missing or invalid.

ForbiddenResponse.description: Returned when the authenticated user is not allowed to perform the requested action.

NotFoundResponse.description: Returned when the requested user or resource cannot be found.

ValidationErrorResponse.description: Returned when request validation fails. The first validation error message is returned in the message field. data is always null.

message.example: The email field must be a valid email address.

OtpInvalidResponse.description: Returned when the submitted OTP does not match the stored value or has expired.

OtpRateLimitResponse.description: Returned when the user has made too many OTP requests within the allowed window (application-level limit, not the Laravel request throttle).

message.example: Too many OTP requests. Please try again later.

TooManyRequestsResponse.description: Laravel default throttle response — 60 requests per minute per API middleware group.

ServerErrorResponse.description: Returned when the API cannot complete the request because of an unexpected server error.

message.example: The available date field must be a date after or equal to today.

first_name.description: Provider first name saved on the user record.

last_name.description: Provider last name saved on the user record.

email.description: Provider email address. It must be unique except for the authenticated user's own email.

phone_number.description: Optional provider phone number. Must be unique and match the phone pattern when supplied.

message.description: Returns 'Verification email sent successfully. Please check your email.' when the email still needs verification, otherwise 'Personal detail added successfully'.

delivery_type.description: Where to deliver the delete-account OTP.

device_token.description: Optional device token to remove from user devices while deleting the account.
